status: GALE01 disc revision 2 verified for the retained retail extraction; only selected listed common/character fields are extracted, not a complete parameter table
frameSemantics: 60 logical simulation frames per second; frame parameters are per-frame, not per-second; a frame count alone does not establish callback countdown order

offsetSemantics.character: byte displacement from ftCo_DatAttrs / the character attributes structure; not the absolute DAT-file offset
offsetSemantics.common: byte displacement from ftCommonData, reached through ftLoadCommonData; not the absolute PlCo.dat-file offset

decompile.rights: No gameplay implementation license established. Only numerical facts, field identifiers and layout observations retained; no implementation copied or translated.

datPublisher.limitation: Publisher calls these unmodified character DAT dumps but does not identify the disc region/revision in the inspected README or JSON. Values must not be promoted to verified NTSC 1.02 extraction.

root.meaning: The retail archive public root resolves through its relocated first slot to the common-parameter block used as p_ftCommonData by Fighter_LoadCommonData.

retailExtraction.extractionMethod: Read only the selected field bytes from the root-referenced common structure in the big-endian retail DAT; interpreted int32/float32 using pinned decompile field declarations. No archive pointers or unrelated table data retained.
